Class EmpiricalPar

java.lang.Object
random.AbstractParameter
random.EmpiricalPar
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCheck, Parameter
public class EmpiricalPar extends AbstractParameter implements Parameter
This is the parameter that should be passed to the empirical distribution.

  • Constructor Details

    • EmpiricalPar

      public EmpiricalPar()
      This is the default constructor. It creates a new empty empirical parameter that must be set with the setPDF method before being used.

    • EmpiricalPar

      public EmpiricalPar(double[] pdf) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      It creates a new empirical parameter. It accepts an array of double greater or equal to zero and verifies that the sum of all these data is one or zero.
      Parameters:
      pdf - array of double for the new empirical distribution.
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException - when any of the provided data is less than zero or the sum of all of them is not one or zero.

    • EmpiricalPar

      public EmpiricalPar(Double[] wpdf) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      It creates a new empirical parameter. It accepts an array of Double greater or equal to zero and verifies that the sum of all these data is one or zero.
      Parameters:
      wpdf - array of Double for the new empirical distribution.
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException - when any of the provided data is less than zero or the sum of all of them is not one or zero.

    • EmpiricalPar

      public EmpiricalPar(EmpiricalEntry[] entries) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      Creates an empirical parameter with these entries (each entry contains a value and a probability). The Empirical can return not only an integer, but also directly an object, given the right probability table.
      Parameters:
      entries - Empirical entries.
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException

  • Method Details

    • getPDF

      public double[] getPDF()
      It returns the value of the parameters for the empirical distribution, that is the vector of double representing the probabilities provided by the user.
      Returns:
      array of double with the probability distribution function tabulated.

    • getCDF

      public double[] getCDF()
      It returns the value of the parameters for the empirical distribution, that is the vector of double representing the cumulative distribution function tabulated.
      Returns:
      array of double with the cumulative distribution function tabulated.

    • setPDF

      public void setPDF(double[] pdf) throws IncorrectDistributionParameterException
      It allows the user to change the value of the parameter of the empirical distribution. Takes an existent array of pdf and tries to convert it in a pdf for an empirical distribution, checking the conditions which must be respected.
      Parameters:
      pdf - array of double containing an existent pdf.
      Throws:
      IncorrectDistributionParameterException - if, among the provided data, there is a value less than zero or the sum of all of them is not one or zero.

    • check

      public boolean check()
      It controls if the parameter is correct or not. For the empirical distribution, the parameter is correct if the values in the pdf array are equal to or greater than zero and they sum up to one or zero.
      Specified by:
      check in interface AutoCheck
      Specified by:
      check in interface Parameter
      Overrides:
      check in class AbstractParameter
      Returns:
      boolean indicating if the parameter is correct or not.
